text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is injured, so I bring her
to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch... So now I'm supposed to just rest?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess there's no chance the infirmary would've suggested I run more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But don't you think banning me from
everything is
a bit extreme?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've got other interests too. You know
what I'm
trying to say, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'm not even trying to be risky
right now.
choice_data_list: Shall we look for what we can do?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What about my next race, huh? Am I not
allowed
to do any preparation?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: If you mess up the prep work, you won't even stand a chance, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fine. It looks like you're not gonna
budge. I'll rest
if that's what you want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seems displeased, but
she
follows my advice and decides to
rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's get back to the—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch. It even hurts to walk. I guess this
was a bad
idea after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we decide to stop training so
that she
can get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay... If I keep my steps light, I
shouldn't feel
any pain.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What should I try first? Hit me with
anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that point onward, we keep an eye
on her
injury and train without pushing
too hard.
